data.body: Plan-review correction: the prior G6 BLOCK treated the five directly instrumented closes as pinned-view runs that were unrepresentative of the default path. That premise is incorrect. The duration probe recorded those closes while the pinned-ticket-view rollout remained default-off, so the 9 to 11 minute padded range describes the current default path after the direct-instrumentation and close-performance changes. The older mixed cohort combines 22 legacy or uninstrumented runs with five current directly partitioned runs and is not the selected current-regime population. The operator reviewed both populations and explicitly approved option A: document plan review as 15 to 20 minutes and gated close as 9 to 11 minutes, without a warning. These values are operating expectations derived by the requested p50 plus 20 percent through p90 plus 20 percent rule. They are not a timeout or hung-operation threshold.
